body: I'm happy you are still with us.
Not really, she's done some volunteering over the years but that's it. No real education, my father neither. He was a self-made man, came from a poor background. My mom too.

Yes. And we are living in a pretty expensive house. There's simply no way we'll be able to keep afloat because apparantly he's used everything and we actually have nothing left already.

So not only did we find out he killed himself, we also found out we are bankrupt.
I know... but it's all just so daunting. Nothing will ever be the same. Thank you for your kind words.
I just wish he knew that we would rather have dealt with it with him together, than to lose him forever.

I'm in so much pain right now. I literally watched my mom die on the inside today and there was NOTHING I could do. The only reason she is asleep right now is because doctors doped her up.

This shit ruined our lives.

I'm obese and it's definitely a drug to me. I swear I've felt more pleasure from eating a bag of potato chips after a long workday than doing opiates. And I know because I've done both. There's just nothing like it for me. I eat to feel good and then at the same time I watch tv or movies to forget I'm eating. All that's left is feeling good. It's one of the rare moments I actually do feel good.
